changelog: 0.9.5.2 (goondocklabs fork): era channels (keep only titles from a range of years, optionally bring in everything from those years) and seasonal channels (only on the guide between two dates each year). Both are on each channel's page. 0.9.5.1 (goondocklabs fork): new settings 'Allow jumping ahead' (off by default, so only what's on now can be watched, like real cable) and 'Allow restarting'. Both also apply to the remote restart/skip controls. 0.9.5: fix a nameless network channel showing up (blank studio names in metadata are skipped; non-Latin network names get their own channels instead of colliding). 0.9.4: one-click setup — a 'Connect to Live TV' button adds the M3U tuner and XMLTV guide in Jellyfin for you (and fixes them if the links go stale). 0.9.3: fresh installs pick a starter lineup from your library — the 10 channels it can fill best (no near-duplicates), numbered 101+; the rest start off. 'Re-pick my lineup' button in Setup & settings. 0.9.2: built-in channels get generic names for new installs (After Hours, Saturday Morning, Action Pack, Classic Cinema, Tearjerkers, Prestige TV, Fright Night, Kids Classics); existing installs keep their current names. 0.9.1: channel page is one page — '+ Add to channel' opens one search for titles, genres, networks & studios and keyword tags; Rebuild schedule button in the toolbar; rules show as removable chips in the AUTO-ADD line; 'Weighted mix' label; 'package' = all your channels. 0.9.0: renamed Channel Free (new logo); settings page rebuilt — channel lineup, Even mix vs Favorites first, Tonight's Mix bar, per-show options menu, changes save instantly, guide status in the header. 0.8.3: guide-update status in settings (progress bar, queued-until-nobody-is-watching, done/failed, Update guide now); self-heal removes leftover guide entries after a rebuild (no more overlapping titles). 0.8.2: Weighted mix.
description: Live-TV channels built from your own library. No contract, no hidden fees.
name: Channel Free
overview: Your library, on the air. Own your channels.
